summary: The discussion proposes adding a SERIALIZED_VALUE logical type to Parquet for BYTE_ARRAY columns that hold serialized messages such as protobuf, FlatBuffers, or Thrift. Participants question whether this truly extends PME, which currently protects at module boundaries, and call for clarification of scope and implementation details. Participants favor including Delta mode in the initial PFOR specification, rename the proposal to FastLanes, and defer adding interleaving and Unified Transpose Layout to later iterations. This aims to improve page sizing and reduce overhead for wide or sparse schemas while preserving row-group statistics for efficient data skipping.
